reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Hashflare cloud mining by inviting viewers to join through a supplied link and pursue accelerated profits of up to one million dollars. It frames the opportunity as low-cost and minimal-risk, reassures viewers of its legitimacy, and demonstrates reinvesting the account balance into additional hashing power.

if you guys want to use the strategy also then be my guest you can also do it together with me
every time you have enough uh on your balance it will be reinvested in more hashing power
you can mine bitcoins and they pay off automatically
it will maximize our profits and we will get to 1 million a lot quicker

opening.argument: The presentation is framed as a personal experiment, not a promise that viewers will receive a particular return. The speaker says he has only just begun, plans to provide updates through day 100, and invites viewers to observe how the strategy works for themselves. That forward-looking format signals uncertainty: the result is to be evaluated over time, rather than treated as established fact. The discussion also identifies a low-cost starting point, allowing a viewer to make an independent judgment about whether the experiment is appropriate before committing more funds.

citations.quote: I just started cloud mining and I wanted to share with you guys the strategy I will be using
I'll make it like a series from day 1 to day 100 and then you guys can see for yourself how the strategy works
i started off with uh let me see with 100 gig of hashes and as you can see guys it's 12 dollars

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats promotional language as a guaranteed outcome. But the million-dollar statement is presented as a goal, while the speaker simultaneously says the series will let viewers see how the strategy works over time. The quoted reinvestment description explains an account setting; it does not establish that returns are guaranteed, that losses are impossible, or that viewers must participate.

citations.quote: the goals of course to go from zero to one million dollars
then you guys can see for yourself how the strategy works
every time you have enough uh on your balance it will be reinvested in more hashing power

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the million-dollar objective merely a goal does not remove its persuasive force: the speaker says compounding will get there much quicker. More importantly, this is not a neutral test. The speaker recommends Hashflare, calls it legitimate, and directs viewers toward automated payouts and reinvestment. A series format can document promotion; it does not turn claims about profitability into a warning.

citations.quote: it will maximize our profits and we will get to 1 million a lot quicker

opening.argument: The central activity is an operational walkthrough of cloud-mining settings and compounding mechanics. The speaker explains how to provide wallet information, select a currency, activate reinvestment, and set the amount to reinvest. The screen captures of the mining dashboard and hardware imagery are consistent with demonstrating how a technical service operates. Viewers are given a process they can inspect and replicate, while the promised updates make this a practical personal case study rather than a substantiated claim that everyone will profit.

citations.quote: all you do is just click on it and then you activate it
you can just set it up on what it will reinvest

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's selected excerpts describe what the software does, not an investment solicitation by themselves. Saying the creator began cloud mining and explaining reinvestment establishes the subject of the tutorial. It does not establish that the video presents verified returns, requires a payment from viewers, or depicts a completed profitable outcome.

citations.quote: I just started cloud mining
this will just keep on compounding and compounding

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough is instructional precisely because it teaches viewers how to enter the promoted service and expand their hashing power. It includes wallet setup, currency selection, and automatic payout claims, not just abstract technology. The dashboard imagery does not verify profitability, and explaining a mechanism does not neutralize the endorsement that Hashflare is legitimate.

citations.quote: the reason why I chose hashflare for this hashflare is a cloud mining company and they are legit
all you need to do is fill in your your your wallet information
then it now you can activate and you can just set it up on what it will reinvest

opening.argument: On the supplied record, this can be understood as promotion of a paid computing service. The description characterizes Hashflare as a cloud-mining platform and emphasizes a low cost of entry, while the speaker contrasts its small-purchase option with a competitor requiring larger purchases. The presentation shows mining equipment and a service dashboard, but the record does not show a downline, recruitment commission, credential theft, or a guaranteed payout. Reinvestment is described as purchasing more hashing power, which is a service-use choice rather than evidence of a pyramid mechanism.

citations.quote: It offers a unique option for mining with a low cost of entry
with Genesis Mining. You can only purchase larger amounts and with HASHFLARE. They give you the option to just purchase small amount
use your current balance to purchase the maximum possible amount of hash rate

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution calls the link and reinvestment deceptive, but the cited material supports ordinary service promotion: the description supplies a join link, and the speaker explains purchasing additional hashing power. The prosecution does not identify a downline, recruitment payment, or credential request. Its conclusion depends on treating any paid mining service as inherently fraudulent, which the supplied excerpts do not establish.

every time you have enough uh on your balance it will be reinvested in more hashing power

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing downline is irrelevant to a paid-mining returns claim. The relevant conduct is the invitation to join, the assurance that Hashflare is legitimate, and the promise that mined bitcoins pay automatically while balances compound into more hashing power. Hardware imagery and a low entry price show presentation, not that the service can deliver the implied returns.
